purpose: PHASE-687 found datasets/movie_analysis/coordinate_extraction/plans/*.json (real, honest, frame-grounded SEMANTIC labels) trustworthy, but exports/source_video_numerical_dna_full/source-video-numerical-dna-full.json's claimed NUMERIC frame_coordinates fabricated (formulaic +0.0001/frame deltas, identical 0.96 confidence across all frames). This file is the minimal real replacement: exactly one genuinely-measured numeric subject bounding box, for the exact frame the existing real plan candidate coordinate_extraction_ghibli_01_v1_cc_001 already identifies, measured directly from the real decoded frame image. It does not modify, extend, or reuse any value from the fabricated file.

source_candidate_ref.note: this measurement targets the exact same real frame that candidate already references; the source plan file itself was NOT modified

frame_extraction.extraction_tool: Python 3.13.12 + imageio 2.37.3, plugin='FFMPEG' (imageio_ffmpeg bundled ffmpeg-win-x86_64-v7.1.exe) -- the same 'imageio+bundled ffmpeg' toolchain the source plan file's own extraction_notes describe using

reproducibility_check.method: invoked the extraction twice, in two independent subprocess calls, writing two separate PNG files
reproducibility_check.result: byte-for-byte identical -- frame extraction from the real source video is fully deterministic and reproducible

frame_content_confirms_real_and_matches_.visible_overlays: Korean-language logo '마녀배달부 키키' (top-left), '4월 15일 4K 리마스터링 개봉' release-date banner (top-right), song/composer credit bar (bottom-right, 'A Town with an Ocean View' / Joe Hisaishi) -- matches the source plan's own disclosed overlay_present:true for this candidate
frame_content_confirms_real_and_matches_.subject_description: the character (Kiki) seen from above/behind in flight, arms spread wide, filling most of the frame -- matches the source candidate's own note ('character fills most of the frame (rear/aerial view), not a wide establishing composition') and its measured_value:'close', which the source plan recorded as a correction from an earlier, wrong estimate ('estimated_wide')
frame_content_confirms_real_and_matches_.conclusion: this is confirmed to be the same real frame the existing trustworthy plan candidate already describes -- not a different or mismatched frame

subject_bounding_box_measurement.method: direct visual inspection of the real decoded frame image by the AI model performing this phase (no algorithmic/thresholding pipeline, no heuristic scoring system, no formula) -- the same direct-observation discipline the source coordinate_extraction plans themselves already used for their categorical fields, extended here to numeric pixel coordinates
subject_bounding_box_measurement.subject: the character's full visible body silhouette (outstretched arms, torso, dress, visible head/hair/bow), i.e. the same subject the source candidate's shot_scale judgment was made about
subject_bounding_box_measurement.coordinate_space: pixel (top-left origin), on the real 1920x1080 decoded frame
subject_bounding_box_measurement.y_max_note: the subject's dress/skirt is visually cut off by the bottom frame edge (not a soft/uncertain boundary) -- both measurement passes independently and unambiguously placed y_max at the frame's own height (1080), which is why its delta is exactly 0, unlike the other 3 edges which carry real, disclosed visual-estimation uncertainty

honest_limitations.measurement_precision: this is AI-model direct visual pixel estimation, not an algorithmic/computer-vision-measured bounding box -- precision is approximate, on the order of +/-5px (~0.3% of frame width/height) based on the two-pass delta observed here, not sub-pixel or algorithmically guaranteed
honest_limitations.independence_of_the_two_passes_is_partia: both passes were performed by the same model within the same session; true independence (e.g. two separate human annotators, or two separate model sessions with no shared context) was not achieved -- the close agreement between the passes should be read as evidence of measurement STABILITY under this method, not as proof of independent-observer agreement
honest_limitations.single_frame_single_subject_only: this measurement covers exactly one frame, one subject, one bounding box -- it is a proof that a genuinely non-fabricated numeric measurement can be produced with this toolchain and discipline, not a template that has been applied at scale. Extending to more frames/subjects/coordinate types (camera_path, motion_vectors, edit_rhythm, scene_remap) is explicitly out of scope for this phase (per PHASE-687's minimum-unit design).

explicit_non_reuse_of_fabricated_layer.fabricated_file_untouched: exports/source_video_numerical_dna_full/source-video-numerical-dna-full.json was not read, modified, corrected, or referenced for any value in this file
explicit_non_reuse_of_fabricated_layer.fabricated_logic_untouched: services/sourceVideoNumericalDnaFullExtraction.ts was not modified, called, or reused
